domain: straight Float32 extended-linear sRGB, signed log2 luminance floor 0.0001; consistentV2; isolated actual DevelopSharpening stage

matching.metric: mean maximum central edge slope / known step contrast, aligned per row; not MTF50
matching.rule: Tune only on split tuning; independently remeasure each acceptance primary edge. Never refit acceptance; matching is per primary row, unmatched data cannot pass/fail a relative quality gate.

primary.rule: Both normalized overshoot+undershoot and mean halo width improve >=10% on equal-weight informative matched primary rows; every primary row must match and may not regress beyond absolute guards. Below-floor primary signals block Go.

fixedParameters.noiseThreshold: none beyond identical frozen existing Detail soft threshold; no separate denoise

scale.sourceGeometry: known area averaging; source-pixel sigma scaling; original pixel evidence is separate from preview

requiredEvidence: Licensed skin, hair, branches against sky, textiles and native RAW-developed regions with matching source provenance
Independent blinded visual judgement consistent with metrics
Complete isolated process-cold/warm end-to-end timing including conversions/transfers and peak RSS
Actual accelerated/backend parity; software preference alone is insufficient
Production cancellation between iterations, rapid slider sequences, A-B-A, stale publication, undo/redo, bounded memory
Versioned production alpha/HDR/profile/persistence/export regressions against merged process contract
decisionOrder: Independent numerical contract failure yields no-go.
Complete matched primary or critical regression yields no-go.
Missing, unmatched or uninformative evidence blocks Go; never fabricate zero or successful evidence.
Production remains unchanged unless every numeric, visual, native, performance and integration requirement passes.
thresholdMeaning: Predeclared engineering limits, not validated perceptual thresholds. No postmeasurement relaxation.
